outlier_insight.headline: **2.7× their own median** — **script** is what broke the pattern.
outlier_insight.pattern_break: Their other clips top out near **14.5M** (e.g. “A stuff stealer got exposed on the spot😮 #usa”); this one **2.7×'d** their median. The break: it leans harder on **script** than their usual tutorial uploads.
outlier_insight.why_it_spread: Spread via **early-engagement velocity** the algorithm caught and amplified.
outlier_insight.steal_this: **One idea, tightly scripted** — no throat-clearing; every line sets up the next.
outlier_insight.replicability_note: the spike came from timing as much as content.
